name: abap2ui5-sql-console
description: SQL Console in Your Browser, built with abap2UI5.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:cloud && npm run check:abap2ui5 && npm run rename
scripts.syfixes: find src -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.auto_downport: rm -rf src/native && (abaplint --fix .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc || true) && npm run syfixes && npm run strip_trailing_ws && abaplint .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc && cp -f .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc abaplint.jsonc && npm run abaplintpathfix
